name: Documentation Site
description: A premium, editorial developer-documentation template for DevSnips built with plain HTML, CSS, Pico CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. A single self-contained SPA with a header, nested left sidebar, main content, and a sticky On-this-page TOC. Covers 15 documentation sections (Documentation Home, Introduction, Getting Started, Installation, Quick Start, Vanilla, Components, Templates, Design Tokens, Guides, API Reference, Examples, FAQ, Changelog, Roadmap, Contributing) via hash routing. Includes nested sidebar navigation with active page state, breadcrumbs, a sticky scrollspy table of contents, section tracking, previous/next navigation, a Cmd+K search command palette, code blocks with a lightweight syntax highlighter, copy buttons, tabbed code blocks, callouts (info/note/tip/warning/danger), responsive tables, badges, API reference blocks, an edit-on-GitHub action, last-updated metadata, and light/dark mode with a no-flash system-preference fallback. Neutral-first design system with one blue accent (never violet/neon), hairline borders, and restrained shadows — following the shared design-tokens.md specification exactly. Fully responsive: the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer, the TOC becomes collapsible, code blocks remain usable, and tables adapt without page overflow, from 320px to 1920px. No React, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind, Bootstrap, backend, database, or CMS.
features: Single self-contained SPA in one preview.html covering 15 documentation sections (Documentation Home, Introduction, Getting Started, Installation, Quick Start, Vanilla, Components, Templates, Design Tokens, Guides, API Reference, Examples, FAQ, Changelog, Roadmap, Contributing) via hash routing — exactly one preview.html per the design-tokens.md convention
Desktop layout: sticky header + nested left documentation sidebar + main content + sticky right On-this-page table of contents, following the reference documentation principle
Nested sidebar navigation with four groups (Start, Library, Reference, Project), expandable parents, active page state via aria-current, and a live filter input
Breadcrumbs, last-updated metadata, reading-time estimate, and an edit-on-GitHub action on every content page
Sticky scrollspy table of contents generated per page from h2/h3 headings, with active-section tracking via IntersectionObserver; collapses to a tappable On-this-page panel below 1180px
Previous/next navigation at the foot of every content page, driven by the canonical section order
Cmd+K (and /) search command palette: filters pages and sub-sections, arrow-key navigation, Enter to open, Esc to close, grouped results with matched-term highlighting

Code blocks with a lightweight vanilla-JS syntax highlighter (HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, Bash) using a stash-and-restore tokenizer, a header with language label, and a clipboard copy button with a Copied state
Tabbed code blocks (e.g. npm/pnpm/yarn) with ARIA tablist semantics and per-tab copy buttons
Five callout variants (info, note, tip, warning, danger) communicating intent without decoration
Responsive tables wrapped in overflow-x:auto containers so they never cause page overflow on narrow screens
Status and category badges (stable, beta, deprecated, accent, neutral, solid) used to communicate state, not decoration
API reference blocks with signature, return type, a parameter table (name, type, optional, description), and an inline runnable example

Light/dark mode: no-flash system-preference detection on first paint plus a persisted header toggle that swaps a curated dark palette (near-black surfaces, muted borders, soft white text — never black + neon purple)

DevSnips design system on top of Pico CSS: primitive -> semantic -> template -> component token layers (--ds-* + --template-*), neutral-first with one blue-600 accent, hairline 1px borders, restrained shadows, an Inter + JetBrains Mono type scale, a base-4 spacing scale, and small radii by default

Responsive by composition: sidebar -> off-canvas drawer (Esc + backdrop to close) below 1024px, TOC -> collapsible panel below 1180px, header compacts and hides labels below 640px, pager stacks to one column — no horizontal overflow at any width from 320px to 1920px

Accessible: skip link, semantic landmarks (header/main/nav/aside/article), ARIA on the search dialog, tablists, drawer, and TOC, :focus-visible rings throughout, keyboard-operable controls (Escape closes overlays, Cmd/Ctrl+K and / open search, arrow keys navigate results), and prefers-reduced-motion guards on every animation

Realistic DevSnips documentation content referencing real repository paths (Vanilla/Templates/, Vanilla/Templates/SaaS Dashboard/, Vanilla/Templates/Documentation Site/, Vanilla/Templates/design-tokens.md), the metadata.json schema, the validation workflow, and the contribution process — no placeholder content
Zero runtime dependencies beyond Pico CSS and Google Fonts loaded from CDNs; open preview.html directly in a browser
accessibility: semantic HTML landmarks (header, main, nav, aside, article)
ARIA roles and labels on the search dialog, tablists, drawer, breadcrumbs, and table of contents
aria-current on active sidebar link and breadcrumb
focus-visible rings on all interactive controls
keyboard-operable: Escape closes drawer/search/modals, Cmd/Ctrl+K and / open search, arrow keys navigate results, Enter activates
prefers-reduced-motion disables page transitions, drawer, and accordion animations
sufficient color contrast (WCAG AA) in light and dark mode
